title: W(3,3) as a Quantum Error-Correcting Code
thesis: Gauge symmetry is interpreted as the stabilizer structure of a W(3,3) quantum error-correcting code.
identifications: The physical Hilbert space is the gauge-invariant code subspace.
Renormalizability is interpreted as protection below distance 13.
Holography is interpreted as the bulk-boundary map of the stabilizer code.
